title: Golden age of alpinism
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Golden age of alpinism", at revision 1300861698, opens: "The golden age of alpinism was the decade in mountaineering between Alfred Wills's ascent of the Wetterhorn in 1854 and Edward Whymper's ascent of the Matterhorn in 1865, during which many major peaks in the Alps saw their first ascents." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1535602, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "the decade in mountaineering between ascent of the Wetterhorn in 1854 and ascent of the Matterhorn in 1865". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
